summary: P1 1.11 -- independent Monitoring-service self-health. The Monitoring Service card no longer trusts its own stale self-report (server overrides it from real systemd state + heartbeat age, by unit not name). Adds WatchdogSec=60/NotifyAccess=main so a wedged poller is recovered by systemd, via a small stdlib sd_notify helper; keepalive only follows a successful state write. A /run marker distinguishes clean vs unclean restarts (SystemEvent on the latter), never flagging a reboot.
